verdict.rationale: WooCommerce has a first-party processor, WooPayments, and its docs cover listing transactions, viewing payouts and issuing refunds. The features page also says the platform comes bundled with the ability to accept major credit cards. However, nothing in the pack shows published card rates or fraud tooling, and WooPayments is presented as one of 140 gateways to choose from rather than built in by default. Missing for 10: published card processing rates, fraud-prevention tooling, evidence that WooPayments ships natively without installing or choosing a gateway, independent hands-on corroboration.
